bookSourceComment: 优化版：提取jsLib，searchUrl编码，添加header，降低webView延迟，作者列显示作者+播音，tocUrl留空减少跳转，respondTime优化，详情页增加分类。原始注释：Search/explore parse SSR Nuxt payload without WebView. Detail/toc use album _payload.json. Playback keeps WebView session bootstrap for stability.

ruleContent.webJs: (function(){try{var m=location.pathname.match(/\/albums\/(\d+)/);var albumId=m&&m[1];var chapterIdx=parseInt(new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('chapter_idx')||'0',10);if(!albumId||!chapterIdx)return null;if(window.__legadoPlayUrl)return String(window.__legadoPlayUrl);if(window.__legadoBusy)return null;if(typeof window.$fetch!=='function'||typeof window.__checkSession!=='function')return null;window.__legadoBusy=true;(async function(){try{await window.__checkSession({force:true});var data=await window.$fetch('/api/play_token',{method:'POST',body:{album_id:Number(albumId),chapter_idx:chapterIdx}});if(data&&data.play_url){window.__legadoPlayUrl=String(data.play_url);}}catch(e){}finally{window.__legadoBusy=false;}})();return null;}catch(e){return null;}})()
